channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Justin Thomas to return from back surgery at Arnold Palmer Invitational
item.description: Thomas revealed the news during Monday night’s TGL doubleheader, in which Thomas participated in the first of two matches.

item.title: Thomas to make Tour return at Arnold Palmer Invitational
item.description: Three months removed from hip surgery, Justin Thomas says he has no physical limitations and is eying to make his 2026 PGA Tour debut at the Arnold Palmer Invitational. Golf Today talks about expectations for Thomas this spring and how his return impacts the Tour.

item.title: Where does the Cognizant Classic fit in the new PGA Tour schedule?
item.description: Does it make sense for the Cognizant Classic to be the second or third event on the PGA Tour schedule going forward? Golf Today discusses why the Champions Course appeals to so many players on Tour and what its future might look like.

item.title: Former LIV player Eugenio Chacarra to play PGA Tour event on sponsor invite
item.description: Chacarra will play the Puerto Rico Open on a sponsor exemption, becoming the first former LIV Golf member to receive an invite to a PGA Tour event.

item.title: Can Jeeno Thitikul win her first LPGA Tour major in 2026?
item.description: Beth Ann Nichols, senior writer at Golfweek, joins Golf Today to discuss Jeeno Thitikul's eighth LPGA Tour victory at Thailand's Siam Country Club Old Course last weekend and what it means to the 23-year-old's chances to win her first major in 2026. Nichols also talks Lydia Ko's career and gives a player to watch this season on the LPGA Tour.

item.title: Cognizant Classic 2026: Second-round tee times, groupings and how to watch
item.description: The first of four Florida stops on the PGA Tour continues Friday at the Cognizant Classic, where Shane Lowry and Ryan Gerard are expected to lead a field that has none of the top 20-ranked players in the world.

item.title: Cognizant Classic 2026: First-round tee times, groupings and how to watch
item.description: The first two groupings hit PGA National before 7 a.m. Thursday. Here's which players will be getting out the earliest and when tournament favorites Ryan Gerard and Shane Lowry are set to tee off.

item.title: NCAA women's golf spring preview: Can anyone top Stanford?
item.description: U.S. Women's Amateur champion Megha Ganne and the Stanford Cardinal enter the spring as the clear-cut No. 1 in women's golf. What schools will look to challenge? Golf Channel's Brentley Romine previews the season ahead.

item.title: NCAA men's golf spring preview
item.description: Vanderbilt men's golf head coach Scott Limbaugh joins Golf Channel's Steve Burkowski and Brentley Romine to preview the Commodore's upcoming season. Romine gives his analysis on the other teams to watch from across the nation from LSU to Pepperdine

item.title: Xander Schauffele gets second chance in TGL match but can't make the most of it
item.description: The best recipe for good golf is a mulligan, particularly a mulligan granted to a major champion and one of the world’s best players.
